native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: 2D Curve Geometry Offset
native_commands.difference: Edits native curve data. Offset affects 2D output geometry rather than creating an independent Maya offset curve; resolution only changes sampling.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Curve Round Bevel Geometry
native_commands.difference: Edits native curve data. Offset affects 2D output geometry rather than creating an independent Maya offset curve; resolution only changes sampling.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Curve Sampling Resolution
native_commands.difference: Edits native curve data. Offset affects 2D output geometry rather than creating an independent Maya offset curve; resolution only changes sampling.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Surface Sampling Resolution
native_commands.difference: Edits native curve data. Offset affects 2D output geometry rather than creating an independent Maya offset curve; resolution only changes sampling.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Bend
native_commands.difference: Simple Deform uses the object local axis and bounding-box limits. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Twist
native_commands.difference: Simple Deform uses the object local axis and bounding-box limits. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Taper / Flare
native_commands.difference: Linear native taper; not independent Maya start/end flare factors. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Stretch / Squash
native_commands.difference: Native stretch and volume compensation; Maya squash bounds differ. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Static Wave
native_commands.difference: Static native XY wave with speed zero; not Maya axial Sine or animated Wave. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Create Enclosing Lattice
native_commands.difference: Creates a 3 by 3 by 3 cage in object space and offsets its upper region; edit cage control points for further shaping. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Shrinkwrap to Selected Mesh
native_commands.difference: Active source, one selected mesh target; nearest surface point with 0.05 offset. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Deform Along Selected Curve
native_commands.difference: Active mesh and one selected curve; native local-axis curve deformation, not multi-wire/dropoff nodes. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Bind to Selected Surface Mesh
native_commands.difference: Binds active mesh to one selected target mesh. Target deformation drives source after binding; topology must remain stable. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Bind to Selected Closed Mesh Cage
native_commands.difference: Mesh Deform cage binding; one closed selected cage must enclose the active source. Not a proximity-distance wrap algorithm. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Bind Corrective Smooth (Smooth Only)
native_commands.difference: Native bind with Smooth Only initially enabled for observable smoothing; disable it in modifier settings for corrective deformation. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Bind Laplacian / Offset Anchors
native_commands.difference: Selected mesh vertices become anchors; at least one unselected vertex is required. Anchors move on local Z after binding. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Smooth Modifier
native_commands.difference: Native iterative vertex smoothing. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Laplacian Smooth Modifier
native_commands.difference: Native Laplacian smoothing, volume preservation disabled. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Cast to Sphere
native_commands.difference: Native spherical coordinate cast, radius 1. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Texture Displace
native_commands.difference: Creates a linked Clouds texture in global coordinates; no UV dependency. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Warp Between Selected Empties
native_commands.difference: Two distinct empty transforms are ordered by object name: from, then to; no falloff. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Add Shell Thickness
native_commands.difference: Native surface shell thickness; not Maya Deform Solidify rigid-region preservation. Parameters: Edit > Adjust Last Operation and native Modifier properties.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Selected Targets to Shape Keys
native_commands.difference: Active mesh receives relative keys from equal indexed topology; first target influence is 1. Source targets remain. World-space target coordinates are converted to source local space.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Hook Selected Points / New Controller
native_commands.difference: Native Hook with selected point membership, a new empty controller and 0.25 world Z offset; not the complete Maya Cluster node system.
native_commands.parameter_entry: Edit > Adjust Last Operation / native tool or modifier properties

native_commands.label: Reset Lattice Grid
